checklist.why: "The footer and bar actions" names no sibling to use instead (IconButton, a Row tap, ChoiceList).
Registers have rules but there is no when-not section naming an alternative.
Hold parts are named; the base button (label, optional leading icon, caption) has no anatomy.
task-end-early has no screen left (farrowing.task-ready ends early with a red hold); the tool register is forked as .sp-tool in piglet processing.
Pressed, focus, busy, armed and unknown are described but not rendered in the preview.
Preview footer buttons measure 44px tall; text action Clear 44x44; only real farrowing/task footers reach 48.
At most two actions per bar, primary right; the preview respects it.
Disabled and waiting differ from enabled by fill colour only; in real screens the reason line is hidden, so nothing else changes.
Verb+count rule stated; no max length, no truncation example; README lists "Save" as a commit example while banning "Save".
Focus ring, aria-disabled waiting, guard(), keyboard two-step hold all specified.
Raw values in bundle.css: #aab2a1, #e9ece3, #92998d, #bdc7b6, #fff1ee, #20291f, #b6c0ad, 13px radius, 52px min-height.
No related-components table and no classification statement.
375px preview has no overflow but does not show every state.

variants.name: primary (commit)
findings: 44px in the preview footer, 48 in hosts; height depends on the host class, not the component.

variants.name: secondary / Back (surface-back; a lone Back fills ink)
findings: Back border/press colours are raw (#b6c0ad, #f5f6f1, #526847); the Sheet preview still labels the exit "Close".

variants.name: danger
findings: Appears only as a hold in real screens; plain danger is seen only in the preview.

variants.name: task-end-early (red-wash)
findings: No screen uses it: farrowing.task-ready draws End task early as a filled red hold. The preview pairs it with End task, two red acts in one bar.

variants.name: tool
findings: Piglet processing forks it as .sp-tool (paper, bordered, icon, three in a row) on piglet-processing.sheet-todo instead of the well-filled pair.

variants.name: text
findings: Hit area exactly 44x44, under the 48 glove floor.

variants.name: hold (primary / danger)
findings: Two caption faces: the Button card is 11px sentence case ("Hold to end"), TaskHold is 9px capitals ("HOLD TO END"); every real screen uses the capitals.

variants.name: waiting
findings: The reason line is visually hidden by the TaskSheet default, so a waiting "Save"/"Submit" looks exactly like disabled with no reason on screen (ADR 0002 requires one persistent line beside the bar).

findings.text: Waiting buttons in real task screens show no reason: TaskSheet hides the status line by default, so piglet-processing.record-death "Save" and sheet-todo "Submit" read as greyed-out disabled.
findings.fix: Make the footer status visible whenever the primary is waiting (status.visible defaults to true when primary.waiting).

findings.text: Height is decided by host classes: 52px bare, 44px in .inspection-phone/.farrowing-phone, 48/56 in footers. Preview footers render at 44px, under the 48 glove floor.
findings.fix: One rule: .button min-height: var(--control-height) (48) everywhere; drop the 44px host override.

findings.text: Copy rule broken in use: the piglet-processing footer says "Submit" (strings submit.n, idf.submit), and the README gives "Save" as a commit example while banning Save/Submit.
findings.fix: Rename to verb+count ("Record 3 items", "Record 12 piglets"); remove "Save" from the Commit register examples.

findings.text: Two hold faces (11px sentence-case caption in Button vs 9px capitals in TaskHold) for the same act.
findings.fix: Keep the farrowing face (TaskHold) as the only hold caption and update the Button card and preview to it.

findings.text: Raw colours and radii in .button CSS (#aab2a1, #e9ece3, #92998d, #bdc7b6, #fff1ee, #20291f, 13px).
findings.fix: Replace with control-border, disabled-fill, disabled-ink, red-wash, ink and radius-control tokens.

findings.text: task-end-early has no screen; the tool register is forked as .sp-tool.
findings.fix: Drop task-end-early (End early is a danger hold); move .sp-tool onto register:"tool".

proposals.name: TaskHold -> Button hold
proposals.why: Same act, two caption faces; TaskHold is only the footer placement.

proposals.name: .sp-tool -> Button tool register
proposals.why: Same job (a mid-sheet act), forked look.
